note: Question shapes from the 25-case memory eval (GRE-373). What Next product cases are verbatim; studio operating cases use a fictional studio so no client or business data lives in this public repo.

cases.q: What is the What Next repository?
cases.fact: The What Next repository is github.com/Danz0zn17/what-next.

cases.q: What is the What Next production cloud URL?
cases.fact: What Next production cloud URL: https://what-next-production.up.railway.app

cases.q: What public site is What Next's landing page?
cases.fact: The What Next landing page is https://whatnextai.co.za

cases.q: What What Next release contains the memory upgrade?
cases.fact: The memory upgrade (freshness, dreaming, pages, roles) shipped in What Next v2.5.0.

cases.q: What command runs a full dreaming pass?
cases.fact: Run a full dreaming (curation) pass with npm run dream.

cases.q: What command previews dreaming without applying changes?
cases.fact: npm run dream:dry reports what dreaming would change without applying anything.

cases.q: What endpoint starts a dreaming pass?
cases.fact: POST /curate/run starts a dreaming pass over the REST API.

cases.q: How can a dreaming run be reversed?
cases.fact: Undo a curation run with POST /curate/undo and its run_id.

cases.q: After how long do volatile facts go stale by default?
cases.fact: Volatile facts not re-checked within their TTL (default 30 days) are flagged stale.

cases.q: What is Example Studio's standard website price range?
cases.fact: Example Studio standard website pricing: R9,000 to R14,000.

cases.q: What is the standard website deposit rule?
cases.fact: Website projects: 40% deposit to start, 60% on launch.

cases.q: Is Example Studio VAT registered?
cases.fact: Example Studio is not VAT registered, so invoices carry no VAT.

cases.q: Which agent deploys builds?
cases.fact: The Builder agent builds, pushes code and deploys.

cases.q: Who reviews every build before the founder sees it?
cases.fact: The Reviewer agent reviews every build before the founder sees it.

cases.q: Who must approve production deploys and merges to main?
cases.fact: Going live needs the founder's approval: production deploys, merges to main, deletes and spending.

cases.q: Where do clients, quotes, invoices and payments live?
cases.fact: Clients, quotes, invoices and payments live in the Ledger app, nowhere else.

cases.q: What are the Pipeline lead stages?
cases.fact: Pipeline stages, one task per lead: lead -> demo -> proposal -> won -> invoiced.

cases.q: Under what project must What Next memory be saved?
cases.fact: Agents save What Next memory under the project example-lab.

cases.q: Where is the founder's Obsidian vault?
cases.fact: The founder's Obsidian vault is at /srv/notes/vault.

cases.q: Can an agent send client WhatsApp or email messages?
cases.fact: Agents never send WhatsApp or email to clients; they draft it for the founder to send.

cases.q: What is the Atlas Netlify site?
cases.fact: Atlas is deployed on Netlify as atlas-example.netlify.app.

cases.q: What is the What Next local API port by default?
cases.fact: The What Next local REST API listens on localhost:3747 by default.

cases.q: What is the local-first source of truth for What Next?
cases.fact: What Next is local-first: SQLite on the local machine is the source of truth, the cloud is a backup.

cases.q: What happens to superseded facts?
cases.fact: Superseded facts are hidden from reads but kept and recoverable, never deleted.

cases.q: What should a nightly memory check do with possible deletion?
cases.fact: The nightly memory check never deletes; it asks the founder for approval instead.

noise: Railway deploys use nixpacks with Node 22 pinned.
The landing page uses Bricolage Grotesque for display type.
Sentry and PostHog are installed before any site goes live.
Supabase auth redirect URLs must include the preview deploy.
The weekly report goes out on Monday morning.
Client logos are exported as SVG and optimised with svgo.
Lenis wraps the root for smooth scroll on marketing sites.
The release checklist runs the customer e2e script before publishing.
Old screenshots are archived in the design folder.
Database backups run nightly at 02:00 SAST.
